fact: The Beijing+30 national report (June 2024) cites Ministry of Education statistics for 2021-2022 school-year figures (19,398 schools, 6,226,516 pupils aged 6-13, girls' dropout rate about 27.8 per cent) and reports ministry health coverage figures without naming the source records.
title: Report of the Republic of the Sudan on the Comprehensive National Review of the Progress Made on the Beijing Platform for Action+30 for the period 2020-2024
publisher: Republic of the Sudan, Ministry of Social Development
